dynamic_reference.G12_inference: plane-stress 45-degree compliance using the separate exact-brand measured in-plane nu12

intended_use: in-phase 30 C, 1 Hz storage-stiffness sensitivity only
limitations: E1/E2/E45 are digitized plotted summary points, not raw sweeps.
nu12 is a separate exact-brand process measurement; nu13, nu23 and out-of-plane scaling remain priors.
G12 is inferred from E45 and measured nu12; it is not a direct shear measurement.
No loss modulus or damping is available.
Do not use as a service-temperature, creep, Prony, fatigue, resonance, or failure law.
The minimum DMA Tg is an exclusion boundary, not an allowable service temperature.
